detected_fault: Flickering and shaking screen issue with screen twitching, black space with colored dots, and screen being pushed upwards
suggested_solution: Run a thorough system diagnostic test (e.g., MemTest86+, Prime95) to identify any potential hardware issues.
Update NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 drivers to the latest version (460.58.08).
Check for BIOS updates and install the latest version (510).
Perform a clean boot and disable any unnecessary startup programs to isolate the issue.
